_comment: Blog categories = the JOB a post does. Platform is a TAG, never a category - the same two-axis rule docs/07 applies to the tool catalog. Names are one word each - a chip is read at a glance, and an ampersand in a chip is noise. Six is the cap: a seventh category means a post has two plausible homes, and split archives never rank.

categories.name: Growth
categories.description: How reach actually works on each network - what the ranking systems reward, what suppresses a post, and the levers a creator controls.

categories.name: Search
categories.description: Getting found through search: YouTube search, Pinterest, hashtags, titles, descriptions and the metadata that decides whether a piece surfaces at all.

categories.name: Content
categories.description: Hooks, captions, titles, scripts and calls to action - the writing that carries a post, with the limits every platform imposes on it.

categories.name: Design
categories.description: Image sizes, safe zones, thumbnails, compression and formats: making one asset work everywhere without being cropped, crushed or covered by UI.

categories.name: Analytics
categories.description: Which numbers mean something, how to calculate them correctly, and what a good one looks like at your follower count.

categories.name: Money
